subject: general
question: Two trains are running in opposite directions with the same speed. If the length of each train is 120 m, and they cross each other in 12 seconds, then find the speed of each train.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed = Total distance ÷ Total time = (120 + 120) ÷ 12 = 20 m/s.

Since the trains run in opposite directions with equal speeds, relative speed = 2 × Speed of each train.

Speed of each train = 20 ÷ 2 = 10 m/s.

Convert m/s to km/h: 10 × (18 / 5) = 36 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of each train = 120 m

Time to cross each other = 12 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Total Distance = Relative Speed × Time

 
 Train 1 (120 m)
 

 v m/s

 
 Train 2 (120 m)
 

 v m/s

 Crossing Time = 12 s
 Relative Speed = 2v

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total distance = Length of Train 1 + Length of Train 2 = 120 + 120 = 240 m

⇒ Let the speed of each train be v m/s.

⇒ Relative speed = v + v = 2v m/s (as they are in opposite directions)

⇒ 240 = 2v × 12

⇒ 240 = 24v

⇒ v = 240 ÷ 24 = 10 m/s

⇒ To convert speed into km/h, multiply by 18/5.

⇒ Speed = 10 × (18 / 5) = 36 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 36 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Opposite Directions

When two objects move towards each other at speeds S₁ and S₂, their relative speed is S₁ + S₂.

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects move in the same direction at speeds S₁ and S₂, their relative speed is |S₁ − S₂|.

Speed Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.
